name: Deviled Eggs with Relish & Chili
description: Classic, tangy deviled eggs with sweet relish and a chili powder dusting.

recipeInstructions.name: Boil the eggs
recipeInstructions.text: Place eggs in a pot and cover with cold water by an inch. Bring to a boil, then cover, turn off the heat, and let sit 12 minutes.

recipeInstructions.name: Ice bath
recipeInstructions.text: Move eggs to a bowl of ice water for 10 minutes to stop the cooking and make peeling easier.

recipeInstructions.name: Peel and halve
recipeInstructions.text: Peel the eggs, slice in half lengthwise, and pop the yolks into a bowl. Arrange whites on a platter.

recipeInstructions.name: Make the filling
recipeInstructions.text: Mash yolks with a fork until fine, then mix in mayonnaise, mustard, relish, and salt until smooth. Taste and adjust.

recipeInstructions.name: Fill and garnish
recipeInstructions.text: Spoon or pipe the filling into the whites (a zip-top bag with the corner snipped works well). Dust with chili powder.

recipeInstructions.name: Chill
recipeInstructions.text: Refrigerate at least 30 minutes, until it's time to leave. Keep covered for transport.
A muffin tin keeps the halves from sliding during transport, or carry whites and filling separately and pipe on arrival.
